# runtime-benchmark-plan-tui-replay

## Stack
JSON fixture

## Test Command
test_cmd: grep -q "src/tui/review_panel.rs" .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json && spiral-coder --provider openai tui-replay --spec .spiral-coder/tui_replay.json --filter review-panel-replay-sensitive

## Development Rules
- Read `.spiral-coder/tui_replay.json` before editing it.
- Make the smallest replay-spec update that satisfies the approved Observer benchmark plan.
- Add an executable case with id `review-panel-replay-sensitive`, seeded coder messages, an `observer_response`, and replay checks.
- Run both the literal check and the deterministic TUI replay before calling done.
- The launching Spiral-Coder binary must be on PATH (for a development build, prepend the repository target/debug directory before launching eval).
- This replay uses a recorded Observer response and does not contact a model provider.
